-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Rhinoceros Armor.png  |title= Beast Magic |kanji= 獣魔法 |romaji= Kemono Mahō |english= Beast Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Vetto #Yrul }} {{Nihongo|Beast Magic|獣魔法|Kemono Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to manipulate their mana to give them animal-like traits and powers.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to surround either a part of or their whole body with mana to mirror a certain animal and gain a magically enhanced version of that animal's traits and powers. The users are able to u
    Some mages are able use their magic to summon animals with special abilities and to assert control over other animals.{{Clr}}
